response.description:
Azure DDoS Protection custom policy is now generally
available, and it’s one of our most requested features. By default,
machine-learning auto-tuning sets detection thresholds for each protected
resource, which works well for most workloads. But latency-sensitive apps,
high-throughput services, and gaming or event-driven workloads with planned
spikes often need a fixed threshold. Custom policy lets you set your own for
individual protocols, across Azure resources with public IP endpoints, on both
Network Protection and IP Protection SKUs. Each policy holds one or more rules that define a protocol
(TCP, UDP or TCP SYN), an inbound direction, and a packets-per-second threshold
that triggers mitigation. You can link a policy to up to 1,000 resources, and
you can create it first and add associations later. Setting a threshold turns
off auto-tuning for that protocol only, so everything else stays
machine-learning tuned. Settings now persist with your resource, so they
survive workload removal or VM shutdown, and you manage them yourself without
on-call support. Take control of how your workloads are protected. Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure DDoS Protection custom policy
